name: udocker 1.3.17
body:
udocker 1.3.17 see the changelog and the documentation for further information.

* Changelog: https://github.com/indigo-dc/udocker/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
* Documentation: https://indigo-dc.github.io/udocker/
* udocker release for Python 2.7 and >= 3.6

Follow these steps to install and run udocker:

```bash
wget https://github.com/indigo-dc/udocker/releases/download/1.3.17/udocker-1.3.17.tar.gz
tar zxvf udocker-1.3.17.tar.gz
export PATH=`pwd`/udocker-1.3.17/udocker:$PATH
```

Test with:

```bash
udocker --help
udocker install
```
